mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and rises by more than 0.25 percentage points over three months, the market prices in prolonged monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, with t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return difference.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand contraction, increasing recession risk and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market with unemployment below 4.0% and employment growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month, inflationary pressures trigger anticipated Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the tight labor market regime condition.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity supporting corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,300,000 units, it signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration, increasing recession risk and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising UNRATE and declining PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY) with policy rates above 4.5%, persistent inflation expectations drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the high inflation with high rates regime condition.
